exec azk init

# Generate one of each type.
exec azk key generate rsa1 --type rsa --bits 2048 --tag env=dev --tag team=core
stdout 'Kind:     rsa'
stdout 'env=dev,team=core'
stdout '2048'
exec azk key generate ec1 --type ec --curve P-384
stdout 'P-384'
exec azk key generate aes1 --type oct --bits 128
exec azk key generate ed1 --type ed25519
! exec azk key generate rsa1 --type rsa
stderr 'already exists'
! exec azk key generate 'bad name' --type rsa
stderr 'invalid name'
! exec azk key generate x --type rsa --bits 1024
stderr 'unsupported RSA size'
! exec azk key generate x --type secret
stderr 'not a key'

# List and filter.
exec azk key list
stdout 'aes1 +oct +active'
stdout 'ec1 +ec +active'
stdout 'rsa1 +rsa'
exec azk key list --type ec
! stdout rsa1
stdout ec1
exec azk key list --tag env=dev
stdout rsa1
! stdout ec1
exec azk key list --tag team
stdout rsa1
exec azk --json key list --prefix e
stdout '"name": "ec1"'
stdout '"name": "ed1"'
! stdout rsa1

# Export public PEM, private JWK, raw oct; import them back under new names.
exec azk key export rsa1
stdout 'BEGIN PUBLIC KEY'
! stdout 'PRIVATE'
exec azk key export rsa1 --reveal-private -o rsa1.pem
grep 'BEGIN PRIVATE KEY' rsa1.pem
exec azk key export ec1 --reveal-private --format jwk -o ec1.jwk
grep '"kty": "EC"' ec1.jwk
grep '"d":' ec1.jwk
exec azk key export aes1 --reveal-private --format raw -o aes1.bin
! exec azk key export aes1
stderr 'no public part'
! exec azk key export aes1 --reveal-private --format pem
stderr 'no PEM representation'

exec azk key import rsa2 --from rsa1.pem
stdout 'Kind:     rsa'
exec azk key import ec2 --from ec1.jwk
stdout 'P-384'
exec azk key import aes2 --from aes1.bin --format raw
stdout '128'
! exec azk key import bad --from aes1.bin
stderr 'cannot detect key format'

# Same key material yields the same thumbprint.
exec azk --json key show rsa1
cp stdout rsa1.json
exec azk --json key show rsa2
cp stdout rsa2.json
exec sh -c 'grep thumbprint rsa1.json > t1; grep thumbprint rsa2.json > t2'
cmp t1 t2

# Public-only import.
exec azk key export ec1 -o ec1.pub
exec azk key import ecpub --from ec1.pub
stdout 'public-only'
! exec azk sign --key ecpub --in ec1.pub
stderr 'only public material'

# Rotation, enable/disable, tags.
exec azk key rotate ec1 --disable-old
stdout '  2 .* enabled'
stdout '  1 .* disabled'
exec azk key enable ec1 --version 1
exec azk key show ec1
stdout '  1 .* enabled'
exec azk key disable ec1 --version 2
! exec azk key disable ec1 --version 9
stderr 'not found'
exec azk key tag ec1 a=1 b=2
exec azk key show ec1
stdout 'Tags:     a=1,b=2'
exec azk key tag ec1
exec azk key show ec1
stdout 'Tags:     -'

# Soft delete, recover, purge.
exec azk key delete ed1
stderr 'Deleted ed1'
exec azk key list
! stdout ed1
exec azk key list --deleted
stdout 'ed1 +ed25519 +deleted'
exec azk key list --all
stdout ed1
! exec azk key delete ed1
stderr 'is deleted'
! exec azk key purge rsa1
stderr 'not deleted'
exec azk key recover ed1
! exec azk key recover ed1
stderr 'not deleted'
exec azk key delete ed1
exec azk key purge ed1
! exec azk key show ed1
stderr 'not found'
exec azk key purge rsa2 --force
! exec azk key show rsa2

exec azk audit tail -n 100
stdout 'cli +key.generate +rsa1'
stdout 'cli +key.export +rsa1 +.*"private":true'
stdout 'cli +item.purge +ed1'
